title: Restrictions
description: Turns device features, apps and iCloud services on or off. Many restrictions only work on supervised devices; unset items keep Apple's default (allowed).

allowCamera.title: Allow camera
allowCamera.description: Off hides the Camera app and blocks taking photos. Unsupervised support is deprecated.

allowScreenShot.title: Allow screenshots and screen recording
allowScreenShot.description: Off also stops Classroom from viewing the screen.

allowAirDrop.title: Allow AirDrop
allowAirDrop.description: Off turns AirDrop off. Supervised only.

allowAssistant.title: Allow Siri
allowAssistant.description: Off turns Siri off. Apple is moving this to declarative Siri settings (iOS 26.4).

allowAssistantWhileLocked.title: Allow Siri while locked
allowAssistantWhileLocked.description: Off turns Siri off on the Lock Screen when a passcode is set.

allowFingerprintForUnlock.title: Allow Touch ID / Face ID unlock
allowFingerprintForUnlock.description: Off requires the passcode to unlock. Unsupervised support is deprecated.

allowLockScreenControlCenter.title: Allow Control Center on Lock Screen
allowLockScreenControlCenter.description: Off hides Control Center while locked.

allowLockScreenNotificationsView.title: Allow notification history on Lock Screen
allowLockScreenNotificationsView.description: Off hides past notifications while locked; new ones still appear.

allowUSBRestrictedMode.title: Allow USB Restricted Mode
allowUSBRestrictedMode.description: Off lets USB accessories connect while the device is locked. Supervised only.

allowHostPairing.title: Allow pairing with computers
allowHostPairing.description: Off blocks pairing with any Mac or PC except the supervising one. Supervised only.

forceAutomaticDateAndTime.title: Force automatic date and time
forceAutomaticDateAndTime.description: On keeps Set Automatically turned on in Date & Time. Supervised only.

allowFindMyDevice.title: Allow Find My Device
allowFindMyDevice.description: Off turns off Find My Device in the Find My app. Supervised only. iOS 13+.

allowEraseContentAndSettings.title: Allow Erase All Content and Settings
allowEraseContentAndSettings.description: Off hides the erase option in Settings. Supervised only.

allowPasscodeModification.title: Allow passcode changes
allowPasscodeModification.description: Off stops adding, changing or removing the passcode. Supervised only.

allowFingerprintModification.title: Allow Touch ID / Face ID changes
allowFingerprintModification.description: Off stops adding or removing fingerprints and faces. Supervised only.

allowAccountModification.title: Allow account changes
allowAccountModification.description: Off stops adding or changing Apple Accounts and Mail, Contacts and Calendar accounts. Supervised only.

allowDeviceNameModification.title: Allow device name changes
allowDeviceNameModification.description: Off stops renaming the device. Supervised only.

allowWallpaperModification.title: Allow wallpaper changes
allowWallpaperModification.description: Off stops changing the wallpaper. Supervised only.

allowBluetoothModification.title: Allow Bluetooth changes
allowBluetoothModification.description: Off stops turning Bluetooth on or off. Supervised only.

allowPersonalHotspotModification.title: Allow Personal Hotspot changes
allowPersonalHotspotModification.description: Off stops changing the Personal Hotspot setting. Supervised only.

allowVPNCreation.title: Allow adding VPNs
allowVPNCreation.description: Off stops users adding VPN configurations. Supervised only.

forceWiFiToAllowedNetworksOnly.title: Only join managed Wi-Fi networks
forceWiFiToAllowedNetworksOnly.description: On limits the device to Wi-Fi networks installed by a profile. Supervised only. iOS 14.5+.

allowUIConfigurationProfileInstallation.title: Allow installing profiles
allowUIConfigurationProfileInstallation.description: Off stops users installing configuration profiles and certificates themselves. Supervised only.

allowEnablingRestrictions.title: Allow Screen Time
allowEnablingRestrictions.description: Off stops users turning on Screen Time restrictions. Supervised only.

allowAppInstallation.title: Allow installing apps
allowAppInstallation.description: Off removes the App Store and blocks all app installs and updates by the user. MDM can still install apps. Supervised only.

allowUIAppInstallation.title: Allow App Store
allowUIAppInstallation.description: Off removes the App Store; apps can still be installed by MDM or Configurator. Supervised only.

allowAutomaticAppDownloads.title: Allow automatic app downloads
allowAutomaticAppDownloads.description: Off stops apps bought on other devices downloading automatically. Supervised only.

allowAppRemoval.title: Allow deleting apps
allowAppRemoval.description: Off stops users deleting apps. Supervised only.

allowInAppPurchases.title: Allow in-app purchases
allowInAppPurchases.description: Off blocks in-app purchases. Unsupervised support is deprecated.

allowMarketplaceAppInstallation.title: Allow alternative app marketplaces
allowMarketplaceAppInstallation.description: Off blocks installing marketplace apps from the web (EU). Supervised only. iOS 17.4+.

allowAppClips.title: Allow App Clips
allowAppClips.description: Off blocks App Clips and removes existing ones. Supervised only. iOS 14+.

allowEnterpriseAppTrust.title: Allow trusting enterprise apps
allowEnterpriseAppTrust.description: Off removes the Trust Enterprise Developer button in Settings.

allowSafari.title: Allow Safari
allowSafari.description: Off hides Safari and blocks web clips. Supervised only.

allowGameCenter.title: Allow Game Center
allowGameCenter.description: Off turns Game Center off. Supervised only.

allowExplicitContent.title: Allow explicit music, podcasts and news
allowExplicitContent.description: Off hides content marked explicit. Supervised only.

ratingApps.title: Maximum app age rating
ratingApps.description: Hides apps above this age rating. Ratings vary by region; these are the common bands.

allowCloudBackup.title: Allow iCloud Backup
allowCloudBackup.description: Off stops backing up to iCloud. Unsupervised support is deprecated.

allowCloudDocumentSync.title: Allow iCloud Drive and document sync
allowCloudDocumentSync.description: Off stops document syncing to iCloud. Supervised only.

allowCloudPhotoLibrary.title: Allow iCloud Photos
allowCloudPhotoLibrary.description: Off turns iCloud Photos off; photos not fully downloaded are removed. Unsupervised support is deprecated.

allowCloudKeychainSync.title: Allow iCloud Keychain
allowCloudKeychainSync.description: Off stops passwords syncing through iCloud. Unsupervised support is deprecated.

allowManagedAppsCloudSync.title: Allow managed apps to use iCloud
allowManagedAppsCloudSync.description: Off stops managed apps syncing with iCloud.

allowOpenFromManagedToUnmanaged.title: Allow opening work documents in personal apps
allowOpenFromManagedToUnmanaged.description: Off keeps documents from managed apps and accounts inside managed apps.

allowOpenFromUnmanagedToManaged.title: Allow opening personal documents in work apps
allowOpenFromUnmanagedToManaged.description: Off keeps documents from personal apps out of managed apps.

requireManagedPasteboard.title: Apply these rules to copy and paste
requireManagedPasteboard.description: On makes the two settings above also limit copy and paste. iOS 15+.

forceAirDropUnmanaged.title: Treat AirDrop as personal
forceAirDropUnmanaged.description: On treats AirDrop as an unmanaged destination for managed documents.

allowRemoteScreenObservation.title: Allow Classroom screen viewing
allowRemoteScreenObservation.description: Off stops the Classroom app viewing this screen.

forceClassroomAutomaticallyJoinClasses.title: Join Classroom classes automatically
forceClassroomAutomaticallyJoinClasses.description: On accepts the teacher's requests without asking the student. Supervised only.

forceClassroomUnpromptedAppAndDeviceLock.title: Let Classroom lock apps without asking
forceClassroomUnpromptedAppAndDeviceLock.description: On lets the teacher lock apps or the device without asking the student. Supervised only.

forceClassroomUnpromptedScreenObservatio.title: Let Classroom view the screen without asking
forceClassroomUnpromptedScreenObservatio.description: On lets the teacher of a managed class view the screen without asking. Supervised only.

forceClassroomRequestPermissionToLeaveCl.title: Ask the teacher to leave a class
forceClassroomRequestPermissionToLeaveCl.description: On makes students ask before leaving an unmanaged class. Supervised only.

forceDelayedSoftwareUpdates.title: Delay software updates
forceDelayedSoftwareUpdates.description: On hides new iOS updates for the number of days below (30 if not set). Supervised only. Removed in iOS 27; use declarative software update settings there.

enforcedSoftwareUpdateDelay.title: Update delay (days)
enforcedSoftwareUpdateDelay.description: How many days to hide a new update. Used with Delay software updates. Supervised only. Removed in iOS 27.
